row.title: White papers, not research papers; no number without a source
row.body: WHITEPAPER-2 and NO-MADE-UP-NUMBERS-1 (Rowan 2026-11-25): papers are executive summary, problem, approach, putting it into practice, trade-offs, next steps and references; no forced results table. Live numbers appear only where a reading exists, each with its source. research.gate() blocks a paper with a number that traces to no measurement, study file or cited reference; a test injects 47% and the gate blocks it. Social posts already pass thought.guard, which blocks numbers not in the paper's data.
